analyzed_vuln.description: Heap out-of-bounds read in Type_MLU_Write when serializing an cmsMLU tag: it iterates up to mlu->UsedEntries and reads mlu->Entries[i] without validating that UsedEntries is within the actually allocated entry count for that cmsMLU object. In this PoV, a malformed profile causes object/type confusion so non-MLU data is later written through the MLU writer, leaving a small allocation (40 bytes) but a larger UsedEntries value, and the loop reads past the heap buffer at mlu->Entries[i].
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In cms_profile_fuzzer, attacker-controlled ICC bytes are opened via cmsOpenProfileFromFile, cmsReadTag(cmsSigGamutTag) loads crafted tag data, then cmsSaveProfileToFile triggers SaveTags -> tag type handler WritePtr. The crafted tag metadata makes SaveTags select the MLU writer (Type_MLU_Write) for data that is not a valid cmsMLU (or has inconsistent internal fields), so Type_MLU_Write trusts mlu->UsedEntries and performs OOB reads while writing per-entry language/country/len/offset records.
